expo-mobile.name: Mobile App (Expo)
expo-mobile.instructions: A React Native Expo app with expo-router. Generate a complete mobile app with proper navigation, screens, and components. Use React Native components (View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, FlatList, Image, etc.) instead of HTML elements. Include proper SafeAreaView, StatusBar, and mobile-specific styling. The app must be installable on phones via Expo Go or EAS Build. Use StyleSheet.create for styling. Support both iOS and Android.

pwa-mobile.name: Mobile PWA
pwa-mobile.instructions: A Progressive Web App (PWA) that can be installed on mobile devices. Generate a complete mobile-first web app with installable PWA manifest, service worker, offline support, and app-like UI. Include proper viewport meta tags, apple-touch-icon, theme-color, and a web manifest. Use touch-friendly UI (44px touch targets, swipe gestures, bottom navigation). The app should feel native when installed on a phone.
